model.description: Three saved ensemble members are evaluated separately, then their sigmoid probabilities are averaged. Named intermediate views show member zero.

provenance.model: Fusion evaluation with final image-only transfer
provenance.source: Saved weapons notebook and native artifacts
provenance.projection: Initial image UMAP: cosine, 25 neighbors, min_dist 0.15, seed 42, no labels. PCA views use three fitted components. Transitions interpolate display coordinates.
provenance.groupScope: Videos in the labeled holdout, not full channel inventories.
provenance.media: 2875 thumbnail URLs derived from recorded YouTube video IDs, loaded on demand. No image files are bundled. Current thumbnails can differ from historical embedding inputs or become unavailable.
provenance.textAuxiliary: Sigmoid of coordinate zero of member 0's text code. This is the branch's auxiliary readout, not a standalone text-model ensemble.
provenance.auditQuestion: Select every image containing a weapon.
